problem: Production /prijzen contained more than one mobile language control. The build-time i18n injector normalized only the first matching mobile switcher, so another visible English control could retain the stale homepage href /en/ and break same-route NL→EN navigation.
root_cause: injectMobileLanguage used a non-global regex and returned immediately after replacing the first existing data-bg-language-switcher=mobile block.

evidence.observed_failure: NL→EN pricing browser navigation timed out while target was /en/prijzen.
evidence.public_markup_observation: Pricing exposed an English mobile language link that resolved to /en/ instead of /en/prijzen.

prevention: Normalize every existing mobile language switcher in one pass.
Use the current logical source route for every NL/EN control.
Regression must include multiple stale mobile controls on a non-home route.
Keep production NL→EN→NL browser roundtrip as terminal authority.
truth_boundary: This learning proves the duplicate-control root cause and prevention; production functional green still requires fresh browser readback.
